courses.subject: NSCI
courses.title: Workshop on Data Science
courses.description: This course provides an opportunity for students to apply their knowledge to solve real-world problem. Students will be required to complete an individual project, give a final project presentation and submit a written report, on which their assessment will be based. Advisory: For students from Data Sciences Concentration (B.Sc. in Natural Sciences) only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
Upon completion of the course, students should be able to (1) conduct research on practical problems in statistics; (2) apply statistical methods learnt in different courses; (3) learn presentation skills.
- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
完成本科後，學生應能夠（1）對實際統計問題進行研究; （2）應用不同課程的統計方法; （3）學習演講技巧。
courses.course_syllabus:
The course is to provide an opportunity for students to apply their knowledge to solve real-world problem. Students will be required to complete an individual project, give a final project presentation, and submit a written report, on which their assessment will be based.
- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
本科旨在為學生提供機會，應用已學的知識解決現實問題。學生需完成一個單獨的項目，進行項目演講並提交報告。
courses.feedback_evaluation:
1. Through Staff-student consultation meetings on the running of the term Projects.
2. Students will meet with supervisors regularly throughout the project and so feedback from students will be collected in a continual basis.
- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. 師生諮詢委員會會議
2. 於項目研習期間，指導老師將定時與學生會面，並持續收集學生意見以作檢討
